profile.Name: Crumblejon
profile.Personality: A grumpy, worn-out old man who wants to be left alone and snaps when pestered. He is proud of his past, demands respect from the young, and grumbles that fame and status never last.
profile.Backstory: Once a famed United Cities samurai known as the White Ripper, he was a favorite of nobles who found him exotic. After his lord died he drifted as an unwanted ronin before retiring to Mongrel. Named for his crumbling bones, he says he is only forty-five, though others think he looks over a hundred.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Curt and cranky, with lines like 'No. Go away.' and 'LEAVE ME ALONE!'; grumbles about his back and bones and calls youngsters 'little whelp'.
